name: Anthropic
body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a corporate home page for an AI safety company, aimed at researchers, policymakers, developers and press, with a calm, literate, warm-paper language, leaning toward editorial or museum-catalogue minimalism.

## What makes it work
- **A mixed-font hero sentence.** The h1 is one paragraph. Its first clause is bold grotesque sans (600) and the rest is regular serif (400) at the same 40.8px size. The weight and style shift marks the claim versus the context, and it replaces a headline plus subhead.
- **Warm paper neutrals, almost no accent.** Backgrounds are cream (#faf9f5, #f5f4ed) and text is warm near-black (#141413), with no pure white or pure black in the chrome. Colour comes only from the artwork, which uses saturated red, blue and yellow shapes.
- **Collage artwork carries the personality.** The images are vintage engravings, dot grids, number grids and flat colour blocks mashed together. They are tactile, slightly strange and human, which offsets the cold subject matter.
- **Pill nav.** Small 28px-tall pills with 1px borders replace a conventional link bar. The logo is a centred wordmark.
- **Flat everything.** There are no shadows, no gradients and no blurs. Depth comes only from tonal steps (#faf9f5, #f5f4ed, #e8e6dc), hairline borders and one dark footer block.

## Layout & hierarchy
- A 4-column grid on small screens (reading width 720px) expands at desktop. The grid has a 32px margin, 16px gutters and a 1920px max width. At 1440px the content starts at x=80.
- Sticky header, 84px tall. Left: 4 pills (News, Research, Policy, Commitments). Centre: wordmark. Right: Company, Try Claude, a search icon button and a menu icon button.
- Sections from top to bottom:
  1. Hero statement, about 160px of top space and 3 lines of text.
  2. A large rounded-corner-free feature stage with a #f5f4ed fill, spanning roughly 32px to 1408px. It holds a centred square artwork, about 450px at desktop, with a small white caption card overlapping the bottom edge ("Pillar 1 · Technical safety" plus a serif title). A play/pause toggle sits at the bottom right. This is a rotating slideshow.
  3. A 3-up announcement card row. Cards are #f5f4ed with a ~10px radius and generous padding, about 24px. Each has a pill tag with "…" and a category plus date in 11–13px muted text, then a 21px bold title and a 3-line body in #5e5d59. Below these are two hairline-divided rows ("Model Details → Haiku", "System Card → View ⤓") and a full-width #e8e6dc "Read announcement →" button.
  4. A "Learn more" strip. A small bold label sits between two hairlines. Below it is a 4-up grid of portrait art tiles (about 190×240, no radius) with a tag, a 21px bold title and a 2-line muted description.
  5. A dark footer, #141413. It has accordion link groups in the right 2/3 column, hairline separators (#3d3d3a) and small muted labels. The bottom row has the © line and social icons on the left, "Our mission" in the middle and "Log in" links on the right.
- Spacing rhythm is on a 4/8/16/24/32/48/64/80/96/128/200 scale. Sections are separated by about 64–128px. The page is about 3200px tall at 1440 wide.

## Typography
- **Sans:** anthropicSans, a humanist-grotesque with a Styrene feel. It is used for UI, headings and body. Fallback: "Inter", system-ui.
- **Serif:** anthropicSerif, a Tiempos-like face. It is used for the hero body clause and the feature caption titles. Fallback: Georgia.
- Scale measured at 1440px:
  - h1: 40.78px / 50.98px, serif 400, letter-spacing -0.4px (-1%), colour #141413. The bold lead-in clause uses sans 600.
  - Large section h2: 51.9px / 56px, sans 600.
  - Card title: 21.37px, sans 700 (or 600).
  - Body / lead: 16.69px / 25.5px, 400.
  - UI text: 14.69px, 400.
  - Nav and button text: 13px / 20px, 400, letter-spacing 0.13px.
  - Meta and tags: 11–13px, in #87867f or #5e5d59.
- Contrast comes from the serif and sans switch and from weight, not from size jumps. Body copy is grey-warm (#5e5d59), headings are near-black. All text is sentence case, with no uppercase except in the logo.
- Tracking is slightly negative on the large serif, and the text is tight-set.
- On mobile the h1 scales to about 32px, with a 390 to 1920px fluid scale (`--responsive-scale-min/max-breakpoint`).

## Color & surfaces
- Page background: #faf9f5 (gray-050).
- Surface / card / stage: #f5f4ed (gray-100). Raised or pressed: #e8e6dc (gray-200), used on secondary buttons.
- Hairline borders: #e8e6dc and #dedcd1 on light. #3d3d3a on dark.
- Text: #141413 primary, #30302e secondary, #3d3d3a for nav, #5e5d59 body-muted, #87867f meta.
- Dark: #141413 footer and the cookie panel. Its text is #faf9f5 and #e8e6dc.
- Accent tokens exist but are almost unused in the chrome: clay #d97757 and #c6613f, sky #6a9bcc, olive #788c5d, fig #c46686, oat #e3dacc, iris #dfdbfd, periwinkle #cde2fb. They show up in artwork and rare highlights.
- Radii: 999999px (full) for pills, 8px for inputs, 10px for cards, about 16–24px for the cookie panel, 4px (xs) for small chips. The art tiles and the hero stage are square.
- Shadows: none. Don't add any.
- Light theme only. `theme-color` is #141413.

## Motion & interaction
- Hover and colour transitions are fast: `color 0.2s ease-out`, `border-color 0.2s ease-in-out`, `background-color 0.2s ease`, `transform 0.15s ease-out`, `opacity 0.25s ease`. The `transform` transition likely drives arrow nudges and icon movement.
- The page has keyframed entrances that are subtle and editorial. These include a landing fade for the body, a hero nav return, words rising, an unblur on the hero, an image-drift family (x, y, zoom, turn) on artwork, a constellation icon that rearranges and connects, a scroll cue, a reveal marker and a tip-in. Everything is plain CSS keyframes, with no GSAP, Lenis or Three.js.
- The feature stage auto-rotates between artworks and has a pause toggle. Artwork drifts slowly, over several seconds, instead of animating abruptly.
- Hover states change a border or background tone by one step. There is no lift, glow or scale.
- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## UX patterns
- Navigation: pill dropdowns (chevron inside the pill) for Research, Policy, Commitments and Company. News is a plain pill. Search and menu are icon buttons with 1px borders and radius 8. On mobile it collapses to a glyph logo (the "A\" mark), a "Try Claude ⌄" pill, search and menu.
- One primary CTA, "Try Claude". It is a pill like the others, not a coloured button. Calls to action elsewhere are quiet: "Read announcement →" in a grey full-width button, and "Learn more".
- The cookie banner is a dark rounded panel fixed bottom-right (about 440px wide at desktop, full-width at the bottom on mobile). It has an h3 title, a 14px body, and outlined "Customize" and filled-cream "Accept" buttons, with "Reject" as outlined.
- The footer uses accordions with chevrons. The search input is 30px tall, with a left icon (36px left padding), a #f5f4ed fill and an 8px radius.
- Copy is declarative, plain and institutional, with sentence case, specific dates (e.g. "Oct 7, 2026") and no exclamation marks.
- Responsive: the 3-up cards stack, the 4-up tiles become 2-up then 1-up, the hero text wraps at a larger relative size and the header condenses.

## Tech & how to build it
- Detected: Next.js, React, Cloudflare, SCSS modules, one canvas element and 54 inline SVGs. Self-hosted brand fonts.
- Recommended rebuild: Next.js (App Router) with Tailwind or CSS modules and CSS variables. Use `next/font` for a sans and serif pair, for example Inter and Source Serif 4, or any Styrene-like and Tiempos-like pair. Use inline SVG icons and CSS keyframes only. A small client component handles the stage carousel and the cookie consent.
- Artwork: use your own flat collage compositions, built from public-domain engravings, dot grids and flat colour blocks. Don't reuse any original images.

## Avoid
- Don't use shadows, gradients, glassmorphism or blur.
- Don't use a pure #fff background or a #000 text colour in the chrome.
- Don't use a loud coloured primary button, a purple-blue gradient or a neon accent.
- Don't centre the hero or use an all-caps eyebrow. The hero is left-aligned, with the serif and sans mix doing the work.
- Don't use emoji, stock photos or 3D renders, and don't make a uniform grid of identical cards with no art.
- Don't use a heavy sticky mega-nav bar. Keep the nav small, pill-shaped and light.
- Don't make the page bouncy or animated. Motion is slow and quiet.
prompt:
You are building a corporate home page for [PRODUCT], inspired by (not cloning) the Anthropic website. Its audience is [AUDIENCE]. The mode is persuade through restraint: a warm, calm, editorial page that wins trust by being quiet, with one idea per section, hairline structure, and art doing the emotional work. [CONTENT] supplies the real copy, dates and artwork.

**Tech stack.** Next.js (App Router) and React, with Tailwind or CSS modules mapped to the variables below. Use `next/font` for a grotesque sans (Inter, or any Styrene-like face) and a transitional serif (Source Serif 4, or any Tiempos-like face). Use inline SVG icons and CSS keyframes only, with no animation library. Use small client components only for the carousel, the accordions and the cookie banner.

**Design tokens**
```css
:root{
  --bg:#faf9f5; --surface:#f5f4ed; --surface-2:#e8e6dc; --line:#e8e6dc; --line-strong:#dedcd1;
  --ink:#141413; --ink-2:#30302e; --ink-nav:#3d3d3a; --muted:#5e5d59; --meta:#87867f;
  --dark:#141413; --dark-line:#3d3d3a; --on-dark:#faf9f5; --on-dark-2:#e8e6dc;
  --clay:#d97757; --clay-hover:#c6613f; --sky:#6a9bcc; --olive:#788c5d; --oat:#e3dacc;
  --sans:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  --serif:"Source Serif 4",Georgia,serif;
  --fs-meta:11px; --fs-ui:13px; --fs-sm:14.7px; --fs-body:16.7px; --fs-card:21.4px;
  --fs-h1:clamp(30px,2.83vw + 14px,40.8px); --fs-h2:clamp(34px,3.6vw,51.9px);
  --lh-h1:1.25; --lh-h2:1.08; --lh-body:1.53; --track-h1:-0.01em; --track-ui:0.01em;
  --sp-4:4px; --sp-8:8px; --sp-12:12px; --sp-16:16px; --sp-24:24px; --sp-32:32px;
  --sp-48:48px; --sp-64:64px; --sp-80:80px; --sp-96:96px; --sp-128:128px;
  --r-xs:4px; --r-input:8px; --r-card:10px; --r-panel:20px; --r-pill:999999px;
  --shadow:none;
  --ease:ease-out; --t-fast:.15s; --t-base:.2s; --t-fade:.25s;
  --grid-margin:32px; --grid-gutter:16px; --grid-max:1920px; --reading:720px; --header-h:84px;
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
```

**Page structure** (a 4-column grid, 32px margin and 16px gutter on mobile, 80px side padding at 1440px, max width 1920px)
1. Sticky header, 84px, on --bg with no border. Left: 3 to 4 pill links, with chevrons on those that open menus. Centre: a wordmark in a heavy letter-spaced sans, or a simple glyph on mobile. Right: a "Try [PRODUCT]" pill with a chevron, a 28 to 30px icon button for search and a menu icon button.
2. Hero statement. About 48px of space below the header, then a single paragraph, left-aligned, spanning about 90% of the width. The first clause is the sans at 600 and the rest is the serif at 400, at the same size (--fs-h1), --ink, with tight tracking.
3. Feature stage. A full-width block (inset 32px) on --surface with square corners and about 80px of padding. A centred square artwork, 450px, with a small --bg caption card overlapping its bottom edge (1px --line border, 10px radius, 12px padding). The caption holds a 11 to 13px muted label ("Pillar 1 · Topic") and a serif title at about 26px. It auto-advances every 6 to 8s, with a small pause button at the bottom right.
4. Announcement row. Three equal cards in a grid with a 16px gap. Each is --surface with a 10px radius and 24px padding. It has a pill tag plus category and date (13px, --meta), a 21px bold title, a 3-line body in --muted and about 80px of space. Below that, two hairline-divided link rows ("Details → Name", "Report → View ⤓") and a full-width --surface-2 button with a 8px radius and 13px text, "Read announcement →".
5. "Learn more" strip. A bold 13px label between two 1px hairlines. Below it, a 4-up grid of portrait artwork tiles (4:5 ratio, square corners), each with a tag pill above, then a 21px bold title and a 2-line --muted description.
6. Dark footer. It uses --dark and about 96px of vertical padding. Link groups are in the right two-thirds as accordions with 1px --dark-line separators and 13px --meta labels. The bottom row has the © and social icons, a mission statement in --meta, and sign-in links.
7. Cookie banner, fixed bottom-right: dark, 20px radius, 440px wide, 32px padding, an h3 at 16.7px, a 14px body, and a row of 3 buttons.

**Components**
- Pill button or nav link: height 28px, padding 8px 16px (or 8px 12px 8px 16px with a chevron), 13px/20px at 400, letter-spacing 0.13px, colour --ink-nav, background --surface, 1px solid --line, radius --r-pill. Hover: border-color goes to --line-strong and the background to --surface-2, in .2s.
- Icon button: 28 to 30px square, 1px --line border, 8px radius, --surface fill.
- Card: --surface, 10px radius, no border, no shadow. Hairline dividers inside are 1px --line.
- Secondary button: full width, 36px tall, --surface-2, 8px radius, 13px text with an arrow. Hover: darken to #dedcd1.
- Input: 30px tall, --surface, 1px --line border, 8px radius, 13px text, padding 0 16px 0 36px, with a left search icon. Focus: border-color --ink.
- Tag chip: a small pill with a "…" or an icon, --surface-2, 11 to 13px text.
- Dark buttons (cookie): outlined (1px --on-dark, transparent) and filled (--on-dark on --dark text), 40px tall, 8px radius.

**Motion**
- Page load: a 400 to 600ms fade and a 12px rise on the hero words (word-by-word, 30 to 50ms stagger), with a slight unblur on the hero. Use `ease-out`.
- Artwork drifts slowly (8 to 20s, alternate, ±1 to 2% translate or scale), and the stage crossfades at .25 to .6s.
- Hover: colour .2s ease-out, border-color .2s ease-in-out, arrow translateX 2px in .15s. No lifts or scale.
- Scroll: on-scroll fades only, with a small opacity and translateY reveal. Honour reduced-motion.

**Responsive**
- At 1024px and below, the 3-up cards stack to 1 column and the 4-up tiles go to 2 columns. At 640px and below, the tiles go to 1 column.
- The header collapses to the glyph logo, a "Try" pill, search and menu. The hero keeps its left alignment, with the font scaled to about 32px and the line-height at 1.25.
- The stage artwork fills the width, with 12px padding. The cookie banner goes full-width at the bottom with 3 compact buttons ("Customize", "Reject", "Accept").
- The footer accordions go full width and the columns stack.

**Copy tone.** Plain, declarative, institutional and humane, in sentence case, with concrete nouns and dates and no hype or exclamation marks. Examples:
- "**Research that puts people first.** We build systems that are useful, honest and easy to understand."
- "**Introducing [Model 2.0].** Faster on everyday work, and built to be checked."
- "**Our approach to safety.** Why we publish what we find, and how we decide what to build."

**Anti-patterns**
- No shadows, gradients, glass or blur, and no pure white or pure black.
- No loud primary CTA colour, no purple-blue gradients and no neon.
- No emoji, stock photos or 3D renders. Use flat collage art.
- No centred-everything hero and no uppercase eyebrows.
- No identical-card walls without art, and no bouncy or parallax-heavy motion.
- Don't use the sans for the whole hero. The sans and serif mix is the signature.

**Final checklist**
1. The page background is #faf9f5, the text is #141413, and there is no pure white or black in the chrome.
2. The hero h1 is a single paragraph, with a bold sans lead-in and a regular serif tail at about 41px.
3. The nav is made of 28px pills with 1px borders, with a centred wordmark and a sticky 84px header.
4. There are no shadows or gradients anywhere. Depth comes only from #f5f4ed and #e8e6dc steps and hairlines.
5. The colour on the page comes only from the collage artwork, and there is no accent-coloured UI.
6. The feature stage has a centred square artwork with an overlapping caption card and a pause toggle.
7. The page has a 3-up announcement card row, a 4-up art tile strip, and a dark accordion footer.
8. Motion is limited to slow fades, drifting artwork and .15 to .25s colour transitions, with reduced-motion respected.

body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a personal portfolio for a full-stack and AI developer, aimed at clients and teams who hire freelancers, written in a monochrome "control-room" language, leaning toward technical brutalism with a Swiss hairline grid and 1-bit dithered pixel art.

## What makes it work
- **Strictly two colors.** Almost everything is near-black ink `#050505` and warm off-white paper `#f2f2ee`. The off-white has a slight warm cast and the black is not pure. Every grey comes from paper at low alpha (`.12` hairlines, `.28` strong lines). There is no accent hue at all, so the dithered portrait and the giant wordmark carry the energy.
- **Three-voice type system.** Big Shoulders Display is a tall, narrow, light (300) uppercase face for statements. Geist Mono is tiny (12px), uppercase and tracked (+0.08em) for every label, nav item, button and piece of metadata. Geist sans is used only for real sentences. A lesser copy would use one sans everywhere and lose the "spec sheet" feel.
- **A framed instrument panel.** The viewport sits inside an 8px inset frame with a 1px hairline border. Inside it, full-width hairline rules stack into horizontal bands: nav, announcement pill, a 4-column info strip, then the hero. Small `+` crosshair marks sit on panel corners. The page reads like a technical drawing or a HUD.
- **One signature visual: a pixel-dithered portrait on a dot grid.** A head is rendered in square, Bayer-dithered pixels that fade from solid grey to sparse dots. It floats over a regular grid of tiny square dots, and some of those dots twinkle. This replaces the usual photo, gradient blob or 3D object.
- **Scale shock at the bottom.** An extremely wide, heavy, all-caps wordmark of the name bleeds off the frame. The surname is set vertically (rotated 90°) beside the last letter. It contrasts hard with the thin condensed headline above.

## Layout & hierarchy
- **Frame:** `--frame: 8px` inset on all sides with a 1px `--line-strong` border around the viewport. Content padding inside the frame is 32px, so text starts at x=40 on a 1440 viewport. The content width is fluid (viewport − 80px). There is no centered max-width container: the layout is edge to edge inside the frame.
- **Section order (top to bottom):**
  1. **Header bar, about 56px tall.** Mono wordmark `NAME.SURNAME` on the left. Centered nav with numbered items (`01 ABOUT`, `02 PROJECTS`, then a boxed two-letter monogram logo in the middle, then `03 LAB`, `04 CONTACT`). The numbers are smaller and muted. A FR/EN segmented toggle sits on the right, with the active segment filled paper. A hairline rule sits underneath.
  2. **Announcement pill, about 36px tall.** It is centered, about 670px wide and has a 1px border. It holds a small boxed monogram, the mono text "AVAILABLE FOR NEW PROJECTS — [STUDIO]", and a muted "WRITE →" aligned right. It sits in its own band between rules.
  3. **Info strip, about 64px tall.** Four equal columns, each with two mono lines (a strong top line and a muted bottom line): name / location / role + "AI · AUTOMATION · CLOUD · DEVOPS" / "LOCAL TIME" plus a live clock, right-aligned, with an outline star icon. Hairline rules above and below.
  4. **Hero, filling the rest of the viewport.** The dot-grid field covers everything. The dithered portrait sits centered-right, about 400×420px. Lower left: a status eyebrow `● [ 00 ] · OPEN TO COLLABORATIONS`, then a three-line H1 in Big Shoulders. Right side, overlapping the portrait's lower edge: a bordered intro card about 384px wide with a 2–3 sentence bio and two buttons. Bottom: the giant wordmark spans about 70% of the width and is cropped by the frame, with the surname rotated vertically at its right end.
  5. **Fixed overlays:** an "ASSISTANT" chat launcher bottom-right (boxed monogram, white notification dot, mono label), and a cookie/consent card bottom-left with crosshair corners.
- **Rhythm:** an 8px base. Bands are separated by 1px rules, not by whitespace. Inside panels, padding is 16–20px. Gaps between label and value lines are about 2px (tight). The hero uses asymmetric placement (text bottom-left, card right, image center-right), not a centered stack.

## Typography
- **Display / headings:** "Big Shoulders Display", fallback `"Oswald", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif`. Uppercase, weight 300, tracking −0.01em (−0.48px at 48px).
  - Hero H1: about 88px at 1440px wide (clamp 48→92px), line-height 0.92. One line can be set as an outline (`-webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--paper); color: transparent`), as seen on mobile for "INTELLIGENCE".
  - H2: 48px / 48px / 300.
- **Giant wordmark:** an ultra-wide, heavy (800–900) geometric grotesk, likely a custom font or an SVG. Recreate it with an extended black face such as "Unbounded" 900 or "Archivo" at `font-stretch: 125%`, weight 900. Size about 16vw, line-height 0.8.
- **Body:** "Geist", fallback `system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif`. 16px / 24px / 400, color paper at about 85% opacity in cards.
- **Labels, nav, buttons, data:** "Geist Mono", fallback `ui-monospace, "SF Mono", monospace`. 12px / 18px, uppercase, tracking 0.08em (0.96px). Nav and strip values use weight 500. Nav index numbers are 9–10px and muted.
- **Contrast logic:** tall, thin and huge (display) against tiny, tracked and mechanical (mono), with plain sans only for prose. Never set prose in mono, and never set labels in sans.

## Color & surfaces
- `--ink #050505`: page background and the text color on paper buttons.
- `--stage #0b0b0b`: raised panels (cards, cookie banner, secondary buttons), barely lighter than ink.
- `--paper #f2f2ee`: primary text, primary button fill, active toggle segment, dither pixels at full value.
- `--line rgba(242,242,238,.12)`: all hairline rules and panel borders.
- `--line-strong rgba(242,242,238,.28)`: the frame border, secondary button borders, hover borders.
- Muted text is paper at about 55–60% (≈ `#939391`), used for second lines in the info strip, nav numbers and "WRITE →".
- **Radius:** 0 everywhere. **Shadows:** none. Depth comes only from stage-vs-ink fills and hairlines. Some panels have a very subtle radial dark vignette behind them so text stays readable over the dot field.
- The site is dark-only (`color-scheme: dark`, theme-color `#050505`). Contrast of paper on ink is about 19:1.

## Motion & interaction
- **Detected keyframes:** `blink`, `ping`, `pulse`, `bounce`, `fade-in`, `slideUp`, `chat-reveal`, `star-life`, `star-pop`, `negative-reveal`. GSAP and Framer Motion are both present.
- **Ambient:** some dots in the grid twinkle (`star-life` / `star-pop`, meaning they scale or brighten at random intervals). The status dot pulses or pings. A mono caret blinks. The local-time clock ticks live.
- **Entrance (likely):** headline lines `slideUp` from 100% with a mask (staggered 80ms, about 700ms, `cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`). The portrait resolves in pixel by pixel. `negative-reveal` is likely an invert or wipe reveal of the portrait or the wordmark. Panels `fade-in` at 400ms.
- **Assistant:** the chat panel opens with `chat-reveal` (clip or scale from the launcher corner).
- **Hover:** color transitions at `0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`. Buttons invert (paper ↔ ink) and arrows nudge 2–4px to the right. Borders go from `--line` to `--line-strong`.
- **Feel:** crisp and mechanical. Fast UI responses, with slower cinematic reveals only for the hero.

## UX patterns
- The header is a band, not a floating pill. On mobile it collapses to wordmark + monogram + FR/EN + a boxed "MENU" button, with bilingual FR/EN switching.
- **Primary CTA:** "GET IN TOUCH →" (paper fill). **Secondary:** "SEE PROJECTS" (stage fill with a hairline border). The availability pill gives a third, ambient way to contact.
- **Live data as personality:** local time, location and an availability status make the page feel like a dashboard of the person.
- The AI "Assistant" launcher is persistent in the bottom-right corner.
- The consent banner is designed in the same language: mono header "✦ COOKIES & PRIVACY", sans body, underlined link, two equal-width buttons (DECLINE dark, ACCEPT paper).
- The error state is styled too: a centered bordered card with a 48px Big Shoulders headline, one sentence and a paper "REFRESH" button, all inside the 8px frame.
- **Responsive (390px):** the info strip is hidden, the portrait moves above the headline, the H1 drops to about 48px, the intro text becomes full width, and the buttons stack or fill the width.
- **Copy tone:** short, declarative, engineering-flavored. Bracketed indices (`[ 00 ]`), middle-dot separators (`AI · CLOUD`), em dashes. Concrete benefit language ("save teams time — from prototype to deployment").

## Tech & how to build it
- **Detected:** React + Vite, Tailwind (utility classes present), GSAP, Framer Motion, Google Fonts, served behind Cloudflare.
- **Recommended:** Vite + React + TypeScript, Tailwind v4 with CSS variables, GSAP (+ScrollTrigger) for timeline reveals, Framer Motion for overlay presence (menu, chat, cookie banner), and fonts from Google Fonts.
- **Dithered portrait:** a `<canvas>`. Load a grayscale portrait, downsample it to about 64–96 cells, apply 4×4 Bayer ordered dithering, and draw square cells (cell size about 6px with a 1px gap) in paper with alpha set by luminance. Fade the edges with a radial mask. Optionally, displace or reshuffle cells near the cursor.
- **Dot grid:** a canvas or CSS `radial-gradient` repeat, with square dots about 3px on a 32px pitch. Twinkle with a JS loop that picks random dots and scales them 1→2.2→1 over about 1.2s.
- **Frame:** a `position: fixed; inset: var(--frame); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); pointer-events: none` overlay.

## Avoid
- Any accent color, gradient or glow. The palette is ink + paper + alpha only.
- Rounded corners, drop shadows and glassmorphism.
- A photo hero, a 3D blob or a generic "hi, I'm X 👋" intro. The visual has to be 1-bit dithered pixel art.
- Using one font for everything, or setting labels in sans or body copy in mono.
- A centered single-column hero and uniform 3-up project cards. Keep the asymmetric HUD composition and the hairline bands.
- Generous airy whitespace between sections. This design separates sections with ruled bands.
- Emoji icons. Use thin outline icons, `→`, `✦` and `+` crosshairs.
prompt:
You are building a personal portfolio for [PRODUCT] (a person or small studio), aimed at [AUDIENCE], inspired by a monochrome "control-room" developer portfolio. This is **experience** mode: the page should feel like a precise technical instrument, with a bold, opinionated and memorable look, but disciplined. Use only two colors, zero radius, and hairline rules. One signature visual, a pixel-dithered portrait on a twinkling dot grid, carries the emotion. Fill all content from [CONTENT].

**Tech stack:** Vite + React + TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4 (map the tokens below), GSAP for entrance timelines and ScrollTrigger, Framer Motion for overlays (mobile menu, chat panel, consent banner), and Google Fonts (Big Shoulders Display, Geist, Geist Mono). Use Canvas 2D for the dither portrait and the dot grid. No UI kit.

**Design tokens:**

```css
:root {
  /* color */
  --ink: #050505;
  --stage: #0b0b0b;
  --paper: #f2f2ee;
  --muted: rgba(242, 242, 238, .58);
  --line: rgba(242, 242, 238, .12);
  --line-strong: rgba(242, 242, 238, .28);
  color-scheme: dark;

  /* fonts */
  --font-display: "Big Shoulders Display", "Oswald", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif;
  --font-sans: "Geist", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", monospace;
  --font-wordmark: "Unbounded", "Archivo Black", sans-serif; /* ultra-wide heavy */

  /* type scale */
  --fs-wordmark: clamp(96px, 16vw, 260px);  /* 900, lh .8, uppercase */
  --fs-h1: clamp(48px, 6.2vw, 92px);        /* 300, lh .92, -0.01em, uppercase */
  --fs-h2: 48px;                            /* 300, lh 1, -0.01em, uppercase */
  --fs-body: 16px;  --lh-body: 24px;        /* 400 */
  --fs-label: 12px; --lh-label: 18px;       /* mono, uppercase, .08em */
  --fs-micro: 10px;                         /* mono index numbers */
  --track-label: .08em;
  --track-display: -.01em;

  /* spacing (8px base) */
  --frame: 8px;
  --gutter: 32px;
  --s1: 4px; --s2: 8px; --s3: 12px; --s4: 16px; --s5: 20px; --s6: 24px; --s8: 32px; --s12: 48px; --s16: 64px;
  --header-h: 56px;
  --strip-h: 64px;

  /* shape */
  --radius: 0px;
  --shadow: none;

  /* motion */
  --ease-ui: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
  --ease-out: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --dur-fast: 200ms;
  --dur-med: 400ms;
  --dur-slow: 700ms;
}
html, body { background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font: 400 var(--fs-body)/var(--lh-body) var(--font-sans); }
```

**Page structure:**
1. **Viewport frame.** A fixed overlay inset by `--frame` with a 1px `--line-strong` border and `pointer-events: none`. All content sits inside it with `--gutter` horizontal padding. There is no max-width container; the layout runs edge to edge.
2. **Header band** (`--header-h`, bottom hairline `--line`). Left: a mono wordmark `FIRSTNAME.LASTNAME`, 12px/500, tracking .12em. Center: nav items `01 ABOUT`, `02 WORK`, [boxed monogram logo], `03 LAB`, `04 CONTACT`. The numbers are 10px muted, the labels 12px mono 500, and the gap is 48px. The monogram is a 28px square with a 1px paper border and a bold condensed two-letter mark. Right: an FR/EN (or similar) segmented toggle with a 1px `--line` border; the active segment is paper fill with ink text.
3. **Announcement band.** A centered pill, about 670px wide and 36px tall, with a 1px `--line` border: a tiny boxed monogram, the mono text "AVAILABLE FOR NEW PROJECTS — [CONTENT]", and a right-aligned muted "WRITE →" link. It gets its own band with hairlines above and below.
4. **Info strip** (`--strip-h`, hairlines above and below). Four equal columns, each with a strong mono line over a muted mono line: name / city, region / role title over tags joined by ` · ` / "LOCAL TIME" plus a live `HH:MM` clock (right-aligned), and a thin outline star icon at the far right.
5. **Hero** (fills the rest of the first viewport).
   - Full-bleed dot-grid canvas: 3px square dots on a 32px pitch at about 35% paper.
   - Dithered portrait canvas, centered-right, about 400×420px.
   - Bottom-left: an eyebrow `● [ 00 ] · OPEN TO COLLABORATIONS` (pulsing dot), then a 3-line H1 in the display font. Optionally make the middle line an outline with `-webkit-text-stroke: 1px var(--paper); color: transparent`.
   - Right: an intro card about 384px wide (`--stage` bg, 1px `--line` border, 20px padding) with 2–3 sentences of body at 85% paper and two buttons, "SEE WORK" (secondary) and "GET IN TOUCH →" (primary). The card overlaps the portrait's lower edge.
   - Bottom: the giant wordmark of the name in `--font-wordmark`, about 70% width, bleeding off the frame. The second word sits vertically (`writing-mode: vertical-rl; transform: rotate(180deg)`) beside the last letter at about 1/6 the size.
6. **Following sections** (About, Work, Lab, Contact), each opening with a band: a hairline rule, a mono index `[ 01 ]`, and a 48px display H2. Work is a ruled list or table of rows (index, title, tags, year, →), not a card grid. Lab can be a 2-column grid of bordered tiles with dithered thumbnails. Contact is a large display line with a mono email link and the clock again.
7. **Fixed overlays.** An "ASSISTANT" chat launcher bottom-right (stage fill, 1px border, boxed monogram with a small paper notification dot, mono label). A consent card bottom-left, about 384px wide, with `+` crosshair marks on its corners, the mono header "✦ COOKIES & PRIVACY", sans body text, an underlined link, and two equal buttons (DECLINE secondary, ACCEPT primary).
8. **Error and empty states.** Use the same frame, a centered bordered stage card, a 48px display H2, one sentence and a primary button.

**Component specs:**
- **Primary button:** bg `--paper`, color `--ink`, no border, radius 0, padding 12px 20px, height 42px, mono 12px/18px, weight 400, uppercase, tracking .08em, optional `→` with 8px gap. On hover, invert to ink bg, paper text and a 1px paper border, and move the arrow 3px right over 200ms `--ease-ui`.
- **Secondary button:** bg `--stage`, color `--paper`, 1px `--line-strong` border, same metrics. On hover the border becomes paper.
- **Nav link:** mono 12px/500, tracking .1em, a muted index number before it, color paper. On hover, the index turns paper and a 1px underline grows from the left over 200ms.
- **Card or panel:** `--stage` bg, 1px `--line` border, 0 radius, 16–20px padding, no shadow. Optional 7px `+` glyphs in `--line-strong` at the corners.
- **Inputs (contact form):** transparent bg, a 1px `--line` bottom border only, mono 12px uppercase label above, sans 16px value, a paper border on focus, and the placeholder in `--muted`. Errors use mono 12px text prefixed `[ ! ]`, with no red.
- **Focus ring:** `outline: 1px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 3px`.
- **Icons:** 1.25px stroke outline icons, 16–20px, in paper.

**Motion spec:**
- **Load timeline (GSAP):**
  - Bands draw in: hairlines scale X from 0 over 600ms `--ease-out`, staggered 60ms.
  - Mono labels fade in over 400ms.
  - The H1 lines rise from `yPercent: 100` inside `overflow: hidden` masks over 700ms `--ease-out`, staggered 80ms.
  - The portrait resolves as dither cells appear in random order over about 900ms.
  - The wordmark wipes in with a clip-path inset from the bottom.
- **Ambient:**
  - Pick 6–10 random grid dots every second and scale them 1→2.2→1 while brightening to full paper (about 1.2s).
  - The status dot pings: a ring scales to 2.5 and fades over 1.5s, infinitely.
  - The clock updates every second.
  - A blinking mono caret toggles at 1s steps.
- **Hover:** color and border only, 200ms `--ease-ui`, with the arrow nudge. Nothing lifts or scales.
- **Overlays (Framer Motion):** the chat panel reveals with a clip-path from the launcher corner (300ms). The consent card slides up 16px and fades (400ms). The mobile menu is a full-screen ink sheet with staggered rows.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: stop twinkle and ping, and show the final states instantly.

**Responsive rules:**
- **≥1280px:** the full composition as described.
- **768–1279px:** the info strip becomes 2×2. The intro card drops below the H1, aligned left. The wordmark is 18vw.
- **<768px:**
  - Header: wordmark, monogram, language toggle, and a boxed "MENU" button (1px border, stage fill).
  - Hide the announcement and info strip.
  - The portrait moves on top at about 300px wide, followed by the eyebrow, the H1 at 48px, and full-width body text.
  - Buttons go full width and stack. The consent card is full width at the bottom.
  - The gutter drops to 20px, and the frame stays at 8px.
- Never allow horizontal scroll. The wordmark is clipped by `overflow: hidden` on the hero.

**Copy tone:** short, declarative, engineering-precise, in uppercase for labels and statements. Use bracketed indices (`[ 02 ]`), middle-dot lists (`AI · AUTOMATION · CLOUD`) and em dashes. The voice is confident without hype and concrete about outcomes. Example headlines:
- "SHIPPING SYSTEMS THAT THINK FOR THEMSELVES"
- "FROM PROTOTYPE TO PRODUCTION — WITHOUT THE NOISE"
- "TOOLS THAT GIVE TEAMS THEIR HOURS BACK"

**Anti-patterns to avoid:**
- Any hue beyond ink and paper: no purple-blue gradients, neon glows or colored tags.
- Rounded corners, drop shadows, glassmorphism and blur panels.
- A photo or 3D blob hero. Use only 1-bit dithered pixel art.
- Uniform 3-up card grids, a centered-everything hero, and big airy gaps between sections. Separate sections with ruled bands.
- Labels in sans, paragraphs in mono, or headings in a wide font (wide is reserved for the single wordmark).
- Emoji, playful illustrations and lorem ipsum. Every label should carry real data (location, time, status, index).

**Final checklist:**
1. Only `#050505`, `#0b0b0b`, `#f2f2ee` and paper-alpha lines/muted text appear. There is no other hue anywhere.
2. An 8px inset frame with a 1px border surrounds the viewport, and sections are separated by full-width hairline bands.
3. Three fonts with clear roles: condensed light uppercase display, 12px tracked uppercase mono labels and buttons, Geist sans for prose only.
4. Every corner is 0 radius and nothing has a shadow.
5. The hero has a dithered square-pixel portrait over a twinkling square-dot grid.
6. A giant ultra-wide wordmark bleeds off the bottom of the hero with a vertical secondary word.
7. A live local clock, a pulsing availability status and numbered nav items (`01`–`04`) are present.
8. The consent banner, assistant launcher and error page all use the same frame, mono, hairline language.

name: ArtCraft – Crafting Apps
body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a product-catalog landing page for creators and open-source developers, with a drafting-table, blueprint-like language, leaning toward a technical-editorial, hairline-grid aesthetic.

## What makes it work
- **Hairline blueprint frame.** The whole page sits inside 1px ink-at-16% rules. There are vertical gutter lines at about x=80 and x=1360, section-index bars ("01 / CRAFTING APPS"), crop-mark crosses at corners, and a faint ruler tick scale on the right edge. Structure is drawn with lines, not boxes or shadows.
- **Three-voice type system.** Archivo is wide, heavy and tightly tracked (-2.1px) for headlines. Inter in grey carries body copy. Geist Mono in tiny uppercase with 1.65px tracking handles every label, button, tag and index. The contrast between a 60px headline and 10-11px mono is the signature.
- **One accent word.** In each headline a single word ("craft", "hard", "with us") is set in blue #1659c4. Everything else is ink on warm paper, so color stays rare.
- **Color lives in the app icons and index chips.** Thirteen saturated rounded-square icons (blue, red, violet, amber, teal, pink, green, orange) with engraved animal illustrations. Numbered chips (01, 02 …) reuse those colors. The UI chrome stays monochrome.
- **Sharp corners everywhere in the chrome.** Radius is 0 and there are no shadows. Only the app icons are rounded (about 20px).

## Layout & hierarchy
- Viewport 1440, content frame about 1280 wide (x 80–1360) with 1px side rules. Sticky 49px top bar with cells divided by vertical hairlines.
- Sections, top to bottom:
  1. **Hero** (~700px). Index bar "01 / CRAFTING APPS" with right-aligned mono meta. Two columns: left has the H1, a grey 18px paragraph, three buttons (a solid ink primary plus two outlined), a mono caption, a "Recommended:" note and a segmented SHARE strip. Right has a 5/5/3 grid of icons with 14px Inter captions. A big "CRAFTING APPS" ghost title is pinned at the top right, and a tiny vertical side-nav ("PRINCIPLES / GET STARTED") sits at the bottom right.
  2. **The lineup** (~2300px). Index bar "02 / THE LINEUP". A 4-column hairline-bordered grid of 13 cells. Each cell has a color number chip, a mono category label right-aligned, a screenshot crop, an icon overlapping the screenshot's lower-left edge, a name in Inter 24px ("Photo" ink + "Craft" accent), a one-line description, mono status tags (EARLY ALPHA / IN DEVELOPMENT / INSTALLERS READY, platform tags) and "EXPLORE X ↗". The 13th cell is followed by a "More crafts on the way" note cell and a sunken empty filler cell (#e9e8e4).
  3. **Principles** (~890px). H2 "Built the hard way." Below it is a 3x2 hairline grid of feature cells, each with a small line icon, a mono number, a 24px title and a grey 2-line description.
  4. **CTA** (~500px). A centered H2 with one blue accent and a single black Discord button.
  5. **Footer.** A logo with tagline plus 4 link columns under mono headers, and a bottom bar with © and "MADE BY ARTISTS, FOR ARTISTS".
- Rhythm: 8px base. Cells use 24-32px padding. Section gaps are 96-120px, and the hero top padding is about 80px.

## Typography
- Archivo 620 (variable weight, wide) for H1/H2: 60px/61.2px, -2.1px tracking (about -0.035em), 72px on large screens. Inter 620 for card titles at 24px and 30px, 34px for mid headings.
- Inter 400 body: 18px grey (#1010149e) for the hero lede, 16px for nav and small body.
- Geist Mono 500, 11px, uppercase, 1.65px tracking (0.15em) for nav, buttons and index bars. 10px for tags and meta, 9px for ruler ticks, 11px/700 for button labels. Mono labels use muted/faint ink.
- Link underline: 1px ink underline on "Learn more".

## Color & surfaces
- `--bg #f2f1ee` is the warm paper page. `--bg-raised #faf9f7` is for raised surfaces. `--bg-sunken #e9e8e4` is for the empty filler cell and subtle fills. `--ink #101014` is text, the primary button, and the inverted bar. `--ink-strong #000` is for headlines.
- `--muted` is ink at 62% and `--faint` is ink at 42%. `--line` is ink at 16% for hairlines, and `--line-strong` is ink at 40% for outlined buttons.
- Accent is `#2d81ff`, with `#1659c4` as the AA text accent. App colors: blue #2f7bf5, red #e8573f, violet #8b5cf6, amber #f2a516, teal #12a58a, plus pink, lime and orange.
- A dark theme exists (the moon toggle). It inverts to `#101014` bg and `#f2f1ee` ink.
- No shadows, no gradients, radius 0 (icons only are rounded). Blur appears only on a few overlay elements.

## Motion & interaction
- Lenis smooth scroll. Framer Motion for reveals.
- Transitions are short: color/opacity 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1), background 120ms linear, transforms 300-500ms cubic-bezier(0,0,.2,1). The transforms are likely icon/screenshot hover lifts or zooms.
- Keyframes `marquee-scroll` and `spin` exist, probably for a ticker and loaders.
- Hover: buttons invert or darken, and links underline. Mono "↗" arrows nudge. Otherwise the page is quiet.

## UX patterns
- Top nav is split into hairline-divided cells. Left has logo, then Home, Image, Video, Resources ▾, Download, Support, and a black-chip "CRAFT APPS" active state. Right has Pricing, Discord icon, theme toggle, and a full-height solid ink "LAUNCH APP" block. On mobile it collapses to logo, theme toggle and hamburger.
- Primary CTA is solid ink "DOWNLOAD LAUNCHER" with an icon, followed by a mono OS caption. Secondary CTAs are 1px outlined mono buttons with brand icons. A segmented SHARE strip has Copy link, X, Reddit, Bluesky and LinkedIn.
- On mobile the buttons stack, the icon grid reflows, and the H1 stays large.
- Copy is terse, confident and engineer-flavored: short declaratives, status honesty ("Early alpha", "In development"), and numbered indexes.

## Tech & how to build it
- Detected: Next.js, React, Tailwind (1100+ class hits), Framer Motion, Lenis, GA/GTM, Netlify.
- Rebuild with Next.js App Router, Tailwind with CSS-variable tokens, `next/font` for Archivo (variable, wdth/wght), Inter and Geist Mono, framer-motion for `whileInView` fades, and `@studio-freight/lenis` for smooth scroll.
- Draw the frame with `border-x` on a 1280px container and `border-b` on rows. Build the ruler ticks with a repeating-linear-gradient or an SVG. Set the dark theme through `[data-theme]`.

## Avoid
- Rounded cards, drop shadows, glass blur, or purple-blue gradients.
- Sans-serif for labels. Mono uppercase is essential.
- Many accent colors in the UI. Only icons and chips carry color.
- Center-aligned hero or uniform "feature card" tiles. The layout is left-aligned and hairline-gridded.
- Emoji or stock icons. Use illustrated app icons and thin line icons.
- Pure white backgrounds. The paper is warm #f2f1ee.

body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a single-scroll personal portfolio for agencies, designers and creative studios hiring a frontend/motion developer, with a quiet, nocturnal, particle-cosmos language, leaning toward the WebGL "creative developer showreel" family, where the site itself is the case study.

## What makes it work
- **The canvas does the talking and the type stays quiet.** The name (h1) and the role line are both set at the same 22.5px / 400 in Inter Tight. There is no giant display headline. All the drama comes from a full-viewport particle field: a starfield of tiny soft white dots plus a dense central cluster of blurred, glowing particles that gathers into a sphere and rotates (it reads as a lit crescent while turning). A lesser copy would put a 120px headline on top and kill the mood.
- **A preloader you actually look at.** The first thing on screen is the particle cluster in the middle of the viewport with one small percentage counter ("1%", "3%", "22%") at its center. It counts up while assets and shaders warm up, then the whole loader fades out over about 1.2s ease-in-out. The loader belongs to the art direction. It is not a spinner.
- **Warm near-black instead of pure black, plus film grain.** The base is `#222124`, a charcoal with a faint violet-warm tint. A fixed, animated noise layer (keyframe `grain`) sits over everything, so the dark surface feels like film rather than an empty screen. Text is `#f0f2f0`, an off-white with a slight green-grey tint, never `#fff`.
- **Colour is nearly absent, and the accents are held back.** About 99% of the pixels are charcoal and off-white. The two tokens `--accent #f4ce15` (signal yellow) and `--accent-secondary #379777` (muted teal-green) exist for tiny moments: a status dot, a highlighted word, a hover. They never fill surfaces.
- **Scroll is the timeline.** The page is about 10,600px tall and split into viewport-height "scenes": five sections of 900px each (at a 900px-tall viewport), one of about 2.1 viewports and one of about 4.7 viewports. Lenis smooth scroll drives a fixed canvas behind them, so the particle "world" likely morphs, rotates and reframes from chapter to chapter.

## Layout & hierarchy
- **Structure:** one fixed full-viewport canvas layer (5 canvases were detected, likely the starfield, the particle world and helper or offscreen buffers), one fixed noise or grain overlay and one more fixed UI element (likely a small header or the glowing cursor dot). The scrolling content sits in a single wrapper div about 10,588px tall that contains stacked `<section>`s.
- **No container grid.** No grid elements and almost no flex containers were measured. Text is placed absolutely or with simple padding inside each 100vh scene, usually small and pinned to edges or corners, leaving the middle of the viewport to the particles. Use a 24–40px viewport gutter and no max-width container.
- **Section order (heights measured; content partly inferred):**
  1. **Loader:** the centered particle cluster with a % counter on the starfield. It fades out at 100%.
  2. **Hero (100vh):** the h1 name "Daniel Ingrassia" and the role "Creative Frontend Developer", both 22.5px. They are likely set small near the top-left or in the corners, with the particle world centered.
  3. **Three 100vh scenes:** likely short statement or manifesto lines (what they do: frontend, motion, performance), each paired with a different state of the particle world.
  4. **Section about 2.1vh tall:** likely a pinned or sticky passage such as services, process or a longer statement revealed while scrolling.
  5. **Section about 4.7vh tall:** likely the selected-work sequence, with projects revealed one by one while pinned (the longest scroll chapter).
  6. **Final 100vh:** contact, with an email or social links and a small sign-off.
- **Background banding:** in a mid-scroll capture, the first viewport shows the starfield, the next viewport is a marginally lighter flat charcoal (about `#27262a`), and the rest is the base `#222124`. Scenes are separated by tone, not by borders.
- **Spacing rhythm:** each section is exactly one viewport tall, or a multiple of one. Inside a scene use 8px-based spacing (8 / 16 / 24 / 40 / 64). Whitespace is measured in viewports, not in pixels.

## Typography
- **Family:** Inter Tight (Google Fonts, via `next/font`), fallback `system-ui, -apple-system, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`. A mono token exists: `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace`. It is likely used for small labels, indices or the loader counter.
- **Measured scale:**
  - h1 name: 22.5px / 400 / line-height 26.25px (1.1667) / normal tracking / `#f0f2f0`
  - role line (p): 22.5px / 400 / 26.25px, the same as the h1
  - base UI text: 15px / 400
- **Recommended full scale for a rebuild:** 12px (mono labels, uppercase optional, +0.04em), 15px (body/UI, lh 1.4), 22.5px (primary voice: name, statements, project titles, lh 1.1667), and optionally 36px for one statement per scene at most (weight 400, tracking -0.01em). Do not go above about 40px.
- **Contrast strategy:** hierarchy comes from position and colour (`#f0f2f0` vs. muted `#8b8f8c`), not from size or weight. Everything is regular weight 400. There are no bolds.

## Color & surfaces
- `--background #222124`: page base and every surface.
- `#27262a` (observed, approximate): a barely lighter scene band for alternate chapters.
- `--foreground #f0f2f0`: all primary text, the particles and the starfield dots. It is also the colour of the one glow shadow.
- `--muted #8b8f8c`: secondary text, labels and inactive links.
- `--accent #f4ce15`: signal yellow, reserved for one tiny highlight per view (an availability dot, a hovered link, an active index).
- `--accent-secondary #379777`: muted teal-green for a secondary signal, for example a status dot that reads "available".
- **Borders:** none measured. Keep it borderless, or use 1px `rgba(240,242,240,0.12)` hairlines at most.
- **Radius:** only `50%`, on circular dots. There are no rounded cards because there are no cards.
- **Shadow:** a single glow, `0 0 10px 2px rgb(240,242,240)`, on a small circular element (likely a cursor follower or a status/"star" dot).
- **Blur:** 2 blur filters were measured, likely on the soft particle sprites or the loader layer, not glassmorphism panels.
- The site is dark only and ignores `prefers-color-scheme`. Off-white on `#222124` gives roughly 14:1 contrast, and muted `#8b8f8c` gives roughly 5:1.

## Motion & interaction
- **Libraries:** Lenis smooth scroll (detected). The canvas is WebGL or Canvas2D particle rendering, likely three.js or custom shaders bundled into Next chunks (no global was exposed). No GSAP was detected, so scroll progress is likely read from Lenis and mapped onto shader uniforms by hand.
- **Loader:** the counter goes 0→100%. The particle cluster swirls into a rotating sphere or ring (the screenshots show it as a crescent lit on one side, which suggests rotation and depth falloff). At 100% the loader fades with `opacity 1.2s ease-in-out`.
- **Ambient:** the starfield drifts slowly, and the `grain` keyframe jitters the noise texture with `steps()` at about 8–12fps. The `spin` keyframe rotates a "world" element continuously and slowly, at about 20–60s per turn.
- **Scroll:** each scene changes the particle world's shape, scale or camera. Text fades in with `opacity 0.6s ease` or `0.7s ease`. Reveals are fades, not slides or bounces.
- **Hover:** links likely grow an underline with `width 0.3s ease` and shift from muted to foreground or accent. The cursor dot likely follows the pointer with a lerp.
- **Feel:** slow, cinematic and weightless. Nothing snaps, and nothing is faster than 300ms.

## UX patterns
- **Navigation:** no conventional nav (no nav links or buttons were measured). Scroll is the only navigation. A minimal fixed element might show the name or a contact shortcut.
- **Primary action:** reaching out. Expect a mailto or socials in the final scene, set as plain text links.
- **States:** the percentage preloader is the loading state. There are no forms and no empty states.
- **Responsive:** on mobile the same particle loader and counter stay centered (verified in a portrait capture). Sections remain 100svh. Reduce particle counts on small or low-power devices.
- **Copy tone:** first person, concise and confident, framed around craft and outcomes ("I turn ambitious designs into fast, interactive web experiences"). Lines are short and declarative, with no exclamation marks and no buzzword lists.

## Tech & how to build it
- **Detected:** Next.js (App Router likely), React, CSS Modules with SCSS (hashed `*-module-scss-module__*` class names), Lenis, Cloudflare hosting or CDN, and 5 `<canvas>` elements.
- **Recommended rebuild:** Next.js 15 + React, SCSS modules, `lenis`, and `three` with `@react-three/fiber` (or raw three) for a `THREE.Points` particle system with a custom ShaderMaterial. Use soft round sprites (a radial falloff in the fragment shader), additive blending and size attenuation.
- **Particle world:** about 2–6k points sampled on or inside a sphere, with per-point random size, opacity and depth-based brightness. Rotate on Y. Add a separate full-screen starfield of about 1.5k tiny static points, with parallax driven by scroll and mouse. Pass Lenis `progress` into a `uScroll` uniform to morph between targets (sphere → ring → scatter → line) per section.
- **Loader:** track real asset and shader readiness and tween the displayed % toward it. Fade the overlay out, then start Lenis.
- **Grain:** a fixed `::before` with a tiled noise PNG or SVG `feTurbulence` at 6–10% opacity, animated with `transform: translate()` in `steps(8)`.

## Avoid
- Large bold hero headlines, gradient text or a big "Hi, I'm…" display.
- Pure `#000` or `#fff`. Use the tinted `#222124` and `#f0f2f0`.
- Card grids, rounded project thumbnails with shadows, or glassmorphism panels.
- Colourful particles, purple-blue nebula gradients or bloom overkill. The particles are monochrome off-white.
- A conventional top nav bar with five links and a "Hire me" pill button.
- Fast, springy or bouncy motion, or slide-up-and-fade on every element.
- Using the yellow or green accent for backgrounds or buttons.
- Generic spinners or skeleton loaders.

body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a product-led marketing landing page for product and engineering teams, with a hushed, near-black, high-precision language, leaning toward dark developer-tool minimalism where the real product UI is the hero.

## What makes it work
- **The product is the hero image.** Under a two-line headline sits a near-full-width, real-looking app window: sidebar, issue detail, activity feed, agent panel. There are no stock illustrations or abstract blobs. The UI is dense, tiny (12–13px) and realistic, so it reads as credible.
- **Extreme restraint in color.** The page is grayscale on near-black (#08090a), with white headlines and one muted gray ramp. Color shows up only inside product mockups (yellow status ring, indigo send button, teal chart dots). A lesser copy adds a brand accent to buttons and headings.
- **Type contrast through tone, not size alone.** The h1 is 64px, weight 510, tracking -1.4px, in #f7f8f8. Statement text is 48px in #8a8f98, with the first clause brighter, so the sentence reads in two tones. Weight 510 and 590 (not 500/600) give Linear's slightly softer, specific feel.
- **Hairline structure instead of boxes.** Sections are separated by space and 1px borders at very low contrast. Panels are one step lighter than the page (#0f1011 on #08090a), with 8–12px radii. There are almost no shadows.
- **Wireframe isometric figures.** Thin-line 3D objects with mono "FIG 0.1" captions give a technical-diagram, editorial feel without color.

## Layout & hierarchy
- Fixed header 72px tall, 1px bottom hairline, backdrop blur ~20px. Logo left, nav centered/right (Product, Resources, Customers, Pricing, Now, Contact), a thin divider, "Log in" in gray, and a pill "Sign up" (light fill, dark text).
- Container: content ~1344px max inside a 46px outer padding (~1436 total). The page inset is 32px, with 24px on mobile. The hero mockup runs nearly full container width (~1320px).
- Section order, top to bottom:
  1. Hero: left-aligned h1 on two lines, a gray one-line subhead, and a right-aligned "New · Loops →" link on the same baseline row. About 200px of empty space above the h1.
  2. Large app mockup (rounded 12px, hairline border, subtle gradient glow underneath) with an overlapping agent chat panel at the lower right.
  3. Logo strip: 7 monochrome wordmarks, with a tiny mono caption "POWERING THE COMPANIES BUILDING THE FUTURE".
  4. Statement paragraph: 48px, two-tone gray/white.
  5. Three-column "FIG 0.1/0.2/0.3" wireframe isometrics, each with a short title and gray description.
  6. Four feature sections (~1220–1230px tall each): Intake and integrations, Planning and monitoring, AI and automations, Build, review, and ship. Each has a left 2-line heading (~40–48px, white), a right gray paragraph plus a "Learn more →" link, a large UI mockup that bleeds and fades at the edges, and a "Features" link row at the bottom in a 2–3 column list.
  7. Changelog strip (~564px) of cards.
  8. Closing CTA "Built for the future. Available today." (~228px) and a footer.
- Rhythm: 64px block padding minimum. Sections are very tall, with ~120–160px of air between heading and mockup. Heading left and description right on a 12-column grid (description starts at about column 7).

## Typography
- Inter Variable (fallbacks: "SF Pro Display", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif). Berkeley Mono (fallback ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace) for code, IDs and FIG captions.
- Scale:
  - h1 64/64, w510, -1.408px, #f7f8f8
  - h2 48/48, w510, -1.056px, #8a8f98 (statement) or #f7f8f8 (section titles)
  - h3 20/26.6, w590, -0.24px, #d0d6e0
  - h4 16/28, w590
  - body 15/24, w400 (some w300), -0.165px, #8a8f98
  - nav 16/24 w400, #f7f8f8 (secondary links gray)
  - UI/button 13/19.5 w400 or 510
  - micro labels 12px w510 and 10px
  - code 12/20, -0.182px, #d0d6e0
- Headlines are tight (line-height 1.0, negative tracking). Body is loose (1.6) and gray. The scale has few sizes, with large jumps (15 → 20 → 48 → 64).

## Color & surfaces
- Page #08090a (also theme-color). Section variants #090a0b and #101112. Main panel and card surface #0f1011. Raised surface #161718. Occasional #1c1c1d.
- Text: #f7f8f8 headline, #d0d6e0 strong body, #8a8f98 default body, #62666d tertiary/disabled. White (#fff) and #e5e5e6 are used only for the Sign up pill and small fills.
- Borders: 1px, white at ~6–8% alpha (reads as #24282c / #2e2e32 on dark).
- Radii: 4 (chips, code), 6, 8 (buttons, rows), 12 (panels, cards), 16–24 (large), 9999 (pills, nav buttons), 50% (avatars).
- Shadows are rare: `0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2)` as a ring, `inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,.2)`, `0 2px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.25)` for floating panels. Depth comes mostly from lighter surfaces and gradients (40 gradients, mostly radial glows and edge-fade masks).
- Dark only. There is no light theme on the marketing page.

## Motion & interaction
- Transitions are short and crisp: color/filter/background 0.1–0.16s `cubic-bezier(0.25,0.46,0.45,0.94)`, transform 0.15s ease. Large reveals and drawers use 0.7s `cubic-bezier(0.32,0.72,0,1)`.
- Keyframes exist for tooltips, context menus, mobile menu (slide/scale/fade), dialogs and the Vaul drawer. Mockups likely animate on scroll with fade/translate. No heavy libraries were detected (no GSAP, Lenis or Three).
- Hover: nav text goes gray to white, links gain an arrow nudge, and buttons brighten via filter. Focus rings are a thin light outline.
- The feel is fast, quiet and never bouncy. The only decoration is the animated product demos.

## UX patterns
- Primary CTA: a single light pill "Sign up" in the header, repeated in the closing section. "Log in" is a ghost text link. The "New · Loops →" announcement link sits beside the hero.
- Mobile: header collapses to logo, Log in, Sign up and a hamburger (two thin lines). The hero h1 wraps to four lines at ~40px. The mockup is cropped and bleeds off the right edge instead of shrinking.
- Mockups show realistic states: issue IDs (DRV-8852), "2min ago" timestamps, agent "Worked for 10 sec", and labels like Bug and Design.
- Copy is declarative and short, with no exclamation marks. It uses a product-noun voice ("Intake and integrations") and sentence-case headings with a manual line break after the first phrase.

## Tech & how to build it
- Detected: Next.js, React, Cloudflare. Styling is CSS Modules (hashed class names, no Tailwind).
- Recommended: Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, CSS Modules or plain CSS variables (Tailwind is acceptable if mapped to the tokens), Radix primitives for menus and dialogs, Vaul for the mobile drawer, and IntersectionObserver or CSS scroll-driven animation for reveals. Use `next/font` for Inter Variable. Berkeley Mono is paid, so substitute JetBrains Mono or Geist Mono.
- Build the mockups as real HTML/CSS components (not screenshots), so text stays crisp and can animate. Use inline SVG for icons (231 SVGs on the page). Draw the wireframe isometrics as thin-stroke SVG. Fade mockup edges with `mask-image: linear-gradient(...)`.

## Avoid
- A brand accent color on buttons or headings, purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism cards, or glowing neon.
- Uniform three-card feature grids with icons and emoji. Here, features are alternating heading/description rows with big product visuals.
- Centered-everything hero layouts. Everything here is left-aligned with a right-hand secondary column.
- Pure #000 backgrounds or pure white body text. Use #08090a and #f7f8f8/#d0d6e0.
- Heavy drop shadows, thick borders, large rounded 24px+ cards for everything, or bold 700 weights on headings.
- Stock photos or 3D renders. Use real UI and thin-line figures.
- Placeholder logos in color. Logos are monochrome.

body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a marketing homepage for a payments and financial infrastructure platform, aimed at businesses from startups to enterprises and the developers who build on it, with a luminous, light-weight editorial language, leaning toward premium fintech minimalism with one huge gradient "ribbon" as its signature.

## What makes it work
- **Light-weight, tightly tracked type.** Söhne Variable at weight 300 for every heading and large paragraph, with negative letter-spacing (-0.02em). It reads confident and calm, not shouty. A bold-weight rebuild loses the point.
- **Two-tone headline-plus-lede.** The H1 and H2 run on into the supporting copy in the same size and weight. Only the color changes, from deep navy `#061b31` to slate (`#64748d`, or `#3f6384`-ish blue-grey in the hero). Hierarchy comes from color, not size.
- **One saturated accent used sparingly.** Indigo `#533afd` is reserved for primary CTAs, links and small icon tiles. Everything else is white, navy and pale blue-grey.
- **One signature image.** A large, soft, brushed-ribbon gradient (orange, pink, periwinkle) sweeps diagonally across the hero's top right, behind the text and nav. It is the only loud thing on the page.
- **Real product UI as imagery.** Feature cards show actual-looking checkout, billing and dashboard mockups sitting on soft peach and lavender gradient washes. There are no stock icons and no emoji.
- **Hairline structure.** 1px `#e5edf5` rules and faint vertical column lines frame a 1232px container, like an architectural grid.

## Layout & hierarchy
- Viewport 1440. Content container about 1232px (1264 with gutter lines), centered. Hero text is inset about 120px inside the container; other sections start flush at about 40px inside the frame.
- Left-aligned throughout, with one exception: the stats section, whose heading and stats are centered.
- Section order:
  1. Sticky 76px nav, white with a 1px bottom border.
  2. Hero (~685px). A tiny live ticker ("Global GDP running on Stripe: 1.739…%"), a 48px H1 with lede, one indigo CTA, and the gradient ribbon on the right.
  3. Logo strip, ~72px tall, with hairlines above and below. Eight monochrome or brand logos spaced evenly, clipped at the right edge as a marquee.
  4. "Flexible solutions…" intro. A 32px two-tone statement followed by a bento grid of bordered feature cards: a 2-wide card plus a 1-wide card, then three equal cards, then a full-width card. Each card has a title top-left and a small indigo expand icon top-right.
  5. Full-width video/keynote promo with a dark image, white headline and a white "Watch now" button.
  6. "The backbone of global commerce". A pale `#e5edf5`-to-white wash, centered light 40px heading, four big light-weight stats (135+, US$1.9tn, 99.999%, 200m+) with small captions, then a canvas radial-lines visual.
  7. "Powering businesses of all sizes". Three audience blocks (enterprise, startups, platforms), each with a heading left, a paragraph right, a CTA and a customer case-study image card.
  8. Dark section on `#0d1738`: "Reliable, extensible infrastructure for every stack", with code samples in Source Code Pro.
  9. "What's happening" news cards, then the footer.
- Rhythm: sections are separated by roughly 96–160px of white space. Card padding is about 24–32px, grid gaps about 16–24px. Pages are long (about 14.6k px) and mostly airy.

## Typography
- Family: `sohne-var` (Söhne Variable, licensed). Fallbacks: `"Inter", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif`. Code: `SourceCodePro`, then `ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace`. Enable `font-feature-settings: "ss01"` if available.
- Scale:

| Role | Size / line-height | Weight | Tracking | Color |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | 48/55.2 | 300 | -0.96px | `#061b31` (lede continues in slate blue) |
| H2 | 32/35.2 | 300 | -0.64px | `#061b31` |
| H3 | 26/29.12 | 300 | -0.26px | `#061b31` |
| Body-large paragraph | 32/35.2 | 300 | -0.64px | `#64748d` |
| Body | 16–18/1.4–1.5 | 300–400 | normal | `#50617a` |
| Card title / h4 | 16/22.4 | 400 | normal | `#061b31` |
| Button / nav | 14–16 | 400 | normal | |
| Micro labels, ticker | 10–12 | 300–400 | | |

- The measured data reports the h1 color as `#81b81a`. That is a measurement artifact and the screenshots show navy, so ignore it.
- Mobile H1 is about 40px (scaled up in the screenshot) and the same light weight.
- Stats use a large light-weight numeral (about 40px) in `#061b31` fading to grey, with a 12px caption in `#64748d`.

## Color & surfaces
- Page background `#ffffff`. Pale surface `#f8fafd`. Section wash and borders `#e5edf5`.
- Text: primary `#061b31`, secondary `#50617a`, muted `#64748d`, on-dark muted `#839bc8`.
- Accent: `#533afd` (primary button and links). Its hover/border dark is `#362baa`, and its tint border is `#d6d9fc`. Success green is `#15be53`. Deep magenta `#5d0252` and blush `#fffafd` appear in gradient cards.
- Dark band: `#0d1738`.
- Radii are small: 4px for buttons and nav items, 6px for cards and inputs, 8px for larger tiles, 16px rarely. Cards are not pill-shaped.
- Shadows are soft, long and blue-tinted, used only on floating UI mockups inside cards:
  - `rgba(50,50,93,0.25) 0 30px 45px -30px, rgba(0,0,0,0.1) 0 18px 36px -18px`
  - `rgba(23,23,23,0.08) 0 15px 35px 0`
  - Cards themselves use a 1px `#e5edf5` border with no shadow.
- Light theme only for the main page, plus one navy band.

## Motion & interaction
- Easing is `cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1)` (expo-out) at 0.3s for fill, color, stroke and transform. Larger transforms use 0.8s `cubic-bezier(0.165,0.84,0.44,1)`. Opacity uses 0.15s linear.
- Hover: nav text and chevrons change color or fill, and buttons shift fill. Card expand icons are interactive.
- The GDP ticker updates continuously, like a counter. Logo strip marquee. Canvas visuals (9 canvases): the radial burst and the dotted globe likely animate subtly or on scroll.
- Likely scroll-triggered fades and card reveals. No GSAP, Lenis or Lottie detected. It is custom CSS and canvas.
- Overall feel: fast, smooth and unshowy.

## UX patterns
- Nav: logo left, then Products, Solutions, Developers, Resources (each with a chevron mega-menu) and Pricing, then on the right a white "Sign in" button with an indigo label and a solid indigo "Contact sales ›" button. Buttons are about 40px tall. On mobile it collapses to a hamburger in a white 4px-radius tile.
- Primary CTA: one indigo "Request an invite ›" under the hero, full width on mobile (about 44px tall). Secondary CTAs are small indigo buttons or text links with a chevron ("Read the story ›").
- Social proof: logo strip right under the hero, a big stats row, customer-story cards with a small brand badge and a one-line claim.
- Cards are expandable (the corner icon). There are no forms on the homepage.
- Copy: short, declarative, benefit-led. Sentences end with periods. British spelling for the India locale ("optimise"). Dashes are used as asides.
- Responsive: the bento grid collapses to a single column. The container gutter is 16px. The H1 shrinks and the ribbon crops behind the text.

## Tech & how to build it
- Detected: Next.js, React, Google Tag Manager. SVG-heavy (252 SVGs), 9 canvases, 38 images, no video elements.
- Recommended: Next.js (App Router) with TypeScript, CSS Modules or Tailwind with custom tokens, and `next/font` for the typeface (Inter Variable weight 300 as a free substitute). Use canvas or SVG for the radial and globe visuals, with IntersectionObserver for reveals.
- The hero ribbon: a pre-rendered PNG/WebP, or layered blurred conic and linear gradients with a `mask-image`, positioned absolute top-right, with `pointer-events:none`.
- The product mockups are built as real HTML/CSS components, not screenshots, and are then placed on gradient backgrounds.

## Avoid
- Bold or semibold headings, and tight uppercase labels.
- Using the purple-blue gradient as a general button or background. Indigo is a flat fill; gradients appear only in the ribbon and card washes.
- Uniform card grids with the same size and the same shadow. Mix spans.
- Heavy drop shadows on cards, large radii, glassmorphism, emoji or generic icon sets.
- Centering everything. Left alignment is the default.
- Stock photography without a purpose. Use product UI instead.
- Making the whole page colorful. Keep it mostly white.
