body:
## Design read
Reading this as: a landing page for a subscription-based web, app and video studio, aimed at Dutch SMB marketing and product owners, with a warm, confident and slightly playful language, leaning toward editorial-brutalist agency design with a soft sage-and-flame palette.

## What makes it work
- **Colossal tight-tracked headline.** The hero is a four-line, all-caps Space Grotesk statement ("Maandag ticket. Donderdag live.") at roughly 160px with negative tracking and staggered indents. The promise IS the visual. The h2s at 83px / -5px tracking keep the same voice.
- **Restricted palette with one hot accent.** Sage (#dbdecd, #b8c0a5) and near-black green ink (#182113) carry the page. Flame orange #ff4500 is reserved for CTAs, tags and big blocks, and it glows (`0 0 45px rgba(255,69,0,.35)`).
- **Light and dark chapters alternate.** Sage hero, then a black section with a tabbed service module, then sage again. Each section change resets the rhythm.
- **Tactile 3D clay-and-diorama illustration.** A grass-and-water block with a tiny robot mascot, and a conveyor belt of deliverables. It is chatty (speech bubble "Klik op mij om te chatten!") and makes the service concrete and warm rather than abstract SaaS.
- **Mono micro-labels as a third voice.** Tiny uppercase JetBrains Mono / Space Grotesk labels (live Amsterdam clock, "AL VERTROUWD DOOR", "SCROLL OM TE VERDERGAAN") add precision and a studio-tool feel next to the huge display type.

## Layout & hierarchy
- Full-bleed sections, 40px side gutters at 1440 (16px on mobile). Content is edge-aligned rather than in a narrow centered container. Page height is about 16.9k px.
- Order:
  1. Floating nav (logo, dropdowns, NL/EN, orange CTA pill).
  2. Hero (902px, #dbdecd): left column with tag pill, giant headline, subcopy, two CTAs, text link, trust logos. Right column is a rounded 34px media panel (about 775x775) with a 3D diorama and a live clock chip.
  3. Marquee strip of services in bold caps, separated by diamond glyphs.
  4. Black statement section with giant orange block-shaped type (staggered blocky lines). Likely a masked or animated headline.
  5. Tabbed services module (Design / Build / Film / Content) with numbered tabs, progress bars, a rounded card with accordion pills (Branding, Animaties) and a gradient-blurred media preview on the right.
  6. AI section on #b8c0a5, with orange block headline, a conveyor-belt 3D illustration and a paragraph.
  7. Horizontal scroll-jacked giant text ("ONZE WERK…") flanking a central video still.
  8. Case studies (4145px).
  9. Ticketflow process (2901px).
  10. How a ticket works (2592px).
  11. Team / pricing, "Vast team. Vaste prijs." on sage.
  12. Chat prompt "Even praten?" with an input "Stel Square een vraag…", then the footer.
- Spacing rhythm: large 100-160px vertical section padding. Inside sections an 8/12/16/24/40 step. Hero copy stack: tag, 24px, headline, 24px, body, 32px, CTAs.

## Typography
- Display: **Space Grotesk**, 500 for h2 (83.52px / 86.86px, tracking -5.01px, about -0.06em), 400 for the hero (about 160px, line-height about 0.9, tracking about -0.06em, uppercase), 700 uppercase for h3 (30.24px, -1.2px).
- Statement paragraphs can be set as display: 123.84px / 104px, -7.43px, uppercase, color #182113.
- Body and UI: **Figtree**. Body 15-20px/400 with generous line-height (about 1.5-1.6), nav 20px/500, buttons 15-16px/600-700, tab labels 21.6px/700, 17px/500 for card titles.
- Labels: **JetBrains Mono** (and Space Grotesk) at 10.5-11px, uppercase, tracking about +0.12em. Used for tags, clock, "Al vertrouwd door".
- Contrast comes from scale: 11px mono against 160px display, with almost no middle sizes in the headline area.

## Color & surfaces
- Background light: #dbdecd (hero, closing), #b8c0a5 (AI and cases sage, deeper), #e2dfd9 / #eeece7 (cards, tab panel). Dark: #0d0d0c page, #201f1d raised, #182113 forest ink (also the text color on light).
- Text: #182113 on sage, #eeece7 on dark, #fff only on orange.
- Accent: #ff4500, used for primary buttons, tag pills, block headline, active tab, the 3D rim light (`--sq-3d-rim`).
- Borders: 1px hairlines in `rgba(24,33,19,.34)` (inset shadow) for secondary buttons and chips, and #eeece7 on dark.
- Radii: 999px (pills and buttons), 12px (small cards, tabs), 24px (cards), 34px (hero media panel), 10px (small).
- Shadows: orange glow `0 0 45px rgba(255,69,0,.35)` on primary CTAs; inset `0 30px 60px -30px rgba(24,33,19,.35)` for depth on panels. No drop-shadow card stacks.
- Gradients are soft and blurred (orange blob melting into sage in the tab preview), never purple/blue.

## Motion & interaction
- **Loader:** a full-screen #0d0d0c overlay (`.sq-loader`). It shows tiny gray mono "WELKOM BIJ", then the slash-slash logo plus "SQUARED" in #eeece7 Space Grotesk bold at about 40px, and a thin 240px progress line with a numeric percent counter (e.g. "51") at its right. Observed running about 14.8s in capture (likely slowed by heavy assets; design it for roughly 1.5-2.5s). It leaves with a leave animation (`sq-loader-leave`, `sq-loader-inner-leave`): the inner content fades and the overlay lifts away to reveal the hero.
- Lenis smooth scroll. Horizontal text sections are scroll-driven (the giant "ONZE WERK" words slide apart around a video).
- Marquee `sq-marquee`: linear infinite, services in caps.
- Floating loops: `sq-hero-still-float`, `lab-still-float`, `feature-pills-drift`, `sq-leaf-sway` (leaf shadow sways over the hero panel), and `sq-footer-hint-bob`. Slow, small amplitude.
- Reveal: `svc-grain-reveal`, `svc-disc-in`, `lab-portal-open`, `lab-line-in` (chat "portal" opens, lines type in, `lab-think`/`lab-dot` thinking dots, `lab-blink` cursor).
- Buttons: a springy hover. Scale about 1.065x1.095 with `cubic-bezier(.34,2.27,.64,1)`, click scale .955x.925 with `cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)`, focus ring inset -.125em with `cubic-bezier(.32,.72,0,1)`. Color and background transitions 0.25s ease-out. Big transforms 1.2s `cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)` (expo out).
- A "Geluid aan" (sound on) toggle with `sq-sound-wave` bars implies background audio/video.
- Feel: soft, bouncy, playful, with smooth long easings on scroll.

## UX patterns
- Nav: logo left, dropdown groups (Diensten, Werk, Tools, Studio), plain link Tarieven, then NL/EN switch in mono and an orange "Plan een call" pill. On mobile: logo, CTA pill, hamburger in a soft square.
- Primary CTA repeated: "Plan een kennismaking →" (orange, 15px/700, radius about 12px). Secondary is a ghost with a hairline border ("Bekijk het werk"). Tertiary is an underlined text link ("Hoe werkt dat precies?").
- Trust row: muted gray-green logos with a mono label and a vertical divider.
- Services tabs: numbered (01-04), progress bars that auto-advance, accordion pills with plus icons.
- An inline AI chat ("Stel Square een vraag…") and a mascot bubble invite interaction.
- Copy: Dutch, direct, short sentences, concrete numbers (vanaf €2.000, 3 werkdagen), the day-of-week rhythm. Bilingual NL/EN.
- Mobile: headline stays about 120px tall, CTAs stack full-ish width, the media panel moves below the copy, and logos truncate to two.

## Tech & how to build it
- Detected: Next.js, React, Tailwind (about 280 class hits plus custom classes), Lenis, Vercel, Cloudflare. Media: 49 img, 9 video, 4 canvas, 21 svg. No GSAP or Framer Motion was detected, so the motion is CSS keyframes plus custom JS.
- Rebuild with Next.js App Router, Tailwind, and CSS variables. Use `lenis` for scroll and IntersectionObserver or scroll-linked CSS variables for the horizontal text and reveals. The 3D scenes are likely pre-rendered clay-style renders or short looping videos with transparent backgrounds. A canvas or three.js layer is optional. Use `next/font` for Space Grotesk, Figtree and JetBrains Mono. The clock chip is a client component using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with timeZone Europe/Amsterdam.

## Avoid
- Don't use a centered max-width 1200 container with three equal cards. Keep the edge-aligned, uneven composition.
- Don't use purple or blue gradients, glassmorphism, neon on black, or emoji icons.
- Don't tone the headline down: the hero fails if it is under about 9vw or if tracking stays at 0.
- Don't scatter orange everywhere. Reserve it for actions, tags and one block headline per chapter.
- Don't use stock photos or flat vector icons. Use tactile 3D or clay-style illustration and real video stills.
- Don't skip the mono micro-labels or the loader handoff.
prompt:
You are building a landing page inspired by (not a clone of) the Dutch studio site Squared: a persuasive, editorial-brutalist marketing page for [PRODUCT], aimed at [AUDIENCE]. Mode: persuade, with bold, confident, playful tone. The core device is a colossal tight-tracked uppercase headline on a warm sage background, one hot orange accent with a glow, alternating light and dark chapters, tactile 3D-style illustration and tiny mono micro-labels. Use [CONTENT] for all copy.

### Tech stack
Next.js (App Router) + React + Tailwind CSS with CSS variables, `next/font` (Space Grotesk, Figtree, JetBrains Mono), `lenis` for smooth scroll, CSS keyframes and IntersectionObserver for motion. Use pre-rendered 3D/clay images or looping muted videos for illustration. Deploy on Vercel.

### Design tokens
```css
:root {
  --sage-100: #dbdecd;   /* primary light bg */
  --sage-300: #b8c0a5;   /* deeper chapter bg */
  --paper: #e2dfd9;      /* cards, tab panel */
  --bone: #eeece7;       /* text on dark */
  --ink: #182113;        /* text on light */
  --black: #0d0d0c;      /* dark chapter bg */
  --raised: #201f1d;     /* dark surface */
  --flame: #ff4500;      /* accent */
  --hairline: rgba(24,33,19,.34);

  --font-display: "Space Grotesk", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif;
  --font-body: "Figtree", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;

  --fs-hero: clamp(72px, 11vw, 160px);   /* lh .9, ls -0.06em, uppercase, 400 */
  --fs-h2: clamp(44px, 5.8vw, 83.5px);   /* lh 1.04, ls -0.06em, 500 */
  --fs-statement: clamp(56px, 8.6vw, 124px); /* lh .84, ls -0.06em, uppercase */
  --fs-h3: 30px;                          /* 700 uppercase, ls -0.04em */
  --fs-lead: 20px;  --fs-body: 15px;  --fs-label: 11px; /* mono, +0.12em, uppercase */

  --gutter: 40px;  /* 16px mobile */
  --s-1: 8px; --s-2: 12px; --s-3: 16px; --s-4: 24px; --s-5: 40px; --s-section: clamp(80px, 11vw, 160px);

  --r-sm: 10px; --r-md: 12px; --r-lg: 24px; --r-xl: 34px; --r-pill: 999px;

  --glow-flame: 0 0 45px rgba(255,69,0,.35);
  --inset-depth: inset 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(24,33,19,.35);

  --ease-spring: cubic-bezier(.34, 2.27, .64, 1);
  --ease-click: cubic-bezier(.4, 0, .2, 1);
  --ease-focus: cubic-bezier(.32, .72, 0, 1);
  --ease-expo: cubic-bezier(.19, 1, .22, 1);
}
body { background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--ink); font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--font-body); }
```

### Page structure
1. **Loader** (see Motion).
2. **Nav**: absolute or sticky on sage, 40px gutters. Logo mark (two slanted bars) plus wordmark in Space Grotesk bold caps. Links with chevrons (Services, Work, Tools, Studio) and a plain link (Pricing). Right: NL / EN in mono, then an orange pill CTA.
3. **Hero** (about 100vh, 2 columns, about 45/55): left holds an orange tag pill (mono caps, white, 11px), the huge staggered-indent headline (4 lines, in a "Day X ticket. Day Y live." rhythm), a 20px lead with a concrete price and turnaround, primary plus ghost CTA, an underlined text link, and a trust row (mono label, vertical hairline, 4 muted logos). Right: a 34px-radius media panel with soft sage gradient, a blurred leaf shadow, a 3D diorama, a mascot speech bubble and a mono chip "13:28 MIDDAG IN AMSTERDAM" (sun icon in orange, pill, hairline border).
4. **Marquee** strip: bold uppercase service names separated by diamonds, infinite linear scroll, on sage with ink text.
5. **Dark statement chapter** (#0d0d0c): giant blocky orange headline, 3 to 4 staggered lines.
6. **Tabbed services module** on dark: rounded 24px container in #e2dfd9 with 4 tabs (active tab filled flame, white, with mono index "01"), thin progress bars that auto-advance, a left card with title, 15px description and ghost CTA, collapsed accordion pills with plus icons, and a right blurred orange-to-sage gradient media preview with a layered mock.
7. **AI/method chapter** on #b8c0a5: orange block headline, a wide 3D conveyor-belt illustration running off-screen, a short paragraph in 20px.
8. **Scroll-driven giant text**: two words of 20vw ink type slide apart around a centered video still, with a mono "scroll om te verdergaan" hint with orange dot.
9. **Case studies**: big 40-50px h3 caps case names, large media, results in mono labels. Vary card sizes.
10. **Process ("Ticketflow")**: numbered steps tied to a sticky visual.
11. **Pricing/team** on sage: giant "Fixed team. Fixed price." statement, a price card, team faces.
12. **Chat/contact**: "Even praten?" heading, an inline input "Ask us a question…" and a call CTA. Footer with legal links, in mono.

### Components
- **Primary button**: bg #ff4500, text #0d0d0c (or white), Figtree 700 15-16px, padding .75em 1em, radius 12px (pill 999px in nav), shadow var(--glow-flame). Hover: scale(1.065,1.095) with --ease-spring 0.4s. Active: scale(.955,.925) with --ease-click. Focus ring offset -.125em.
- **Ghost button**: transparent, 1px hairline (inset shadow `0 0 0 1px var(--hairline)`), radius 12px, ink text 600, height 45px.
- **Tag pill**: flame bg, white mono 11px caps, +0.12em, radius 999px, padding 6px 12px.
- **Info chip**: pill, hairline border, mono caps, orange dot or icon.
- **Tabs**: 82px high, padding 25px 36px, Figtree 700 21.6px, mono index suffix; active = flame fill. Panel radius 24px.
- **Accordion pill**: radius 999px, bg rgba(24,33,19,.08), 700 caps 15px, plus icon.
- **Input**: 40px high, borderless on a pill or soft container, 15px Figtree, placeholder in ink at 60%.
- **Media panel**: radius 34px, overflow hidden, soft inset depth.

### Motion
- **Loader/intro**: full-screen #0d0d0c fixed overlay. Centered: mono 11px gray "WELKOM BIJ", then logo plus "SQUARED" in bone Space Grotesk bold about 40px. Below: a 240px 1px progress line and a numeric counter 0 to 100 at its right (mono, bone). Run 1.5-2.5s, then fade the inner content (about 0.4s) and slide or fade the overlay away (about 0.8s, --ease-expo) revealing the hero, whose lines then rise in staggered (80ms apart).
- Lenis smooth scroll (lerp about 0.1). Scroll-linked horizontal text slide and tab auto-advance (about 6s per tab).
- Marquee: 30-40s linear infinite. Floating illustrations: 6-8s ease-in-out, 6-12px amplitude. Leaf shadow sway: 10s.
- Reveals: opacity 0.5s ease plus translateY 24px to 0, over 1.2s --ease-expo. Color and background hovers 0.25s ease-out.
- Chat portal opens with scale and clip reveal, typing dots pulse (blink), lines fade in.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`: disable marquee, floats and scroll-jacking.

### Responsive
- At 1440: 40px gutters, hero two columns. At ≤900px: single column, hero headline about 72-80px, media panel moves below the CTAs at full width, radius 34px stays.
- Nav collapses to logo, orange pill and a hamburger in a 48px soft square. CTAs stack and become wide. Trust row keeps two logos.
- Giant scroll text scales with vw. Tabs become horizontally scrollable or stack. Keep 16px gutters and section padding of about 80px.

### Copy tone
Direct, short, concrete, with weekday and number rhythm and a touch of dry humor. Sentence fragments with full stops. Examples (adapt to [PRODUCT]):
- "Monday brief. Thursday live."
- "One team. One price. Zero surprises."
- "Everything you'd hire three agencies for."

### Anti-patterns
- No uniform three-card grids or centered 1200px container.
- No purple/blue gradients, glassmorphism, neon, emoji icons, stock photos or flat vector spot art.
- No timid headline sizes or default tracking.
- Don't spread orange widely. Don't use heavy drop shadows.
- No lorem ipsum. Use concrete prices, days and names.

### Final checklist
- [ ] Hero headline is at least about 9vw, all caps, tracking about -0.06em, line-height about 0.9, with staggered indents, in ink #182113 on #dbdecd.
- [ ] Orange #ff4500 appears only on CTAs, tags, active tab and one block headline, with the 45px glow on primary buttons.
- [ ] Light sage and dark #0d0d0c chapters alternate, with a services marquee between hero and the dark section.
- [ ] Mono 11px uppercase micro-labels (clock chip, trust label, scroll hint) are present.
- [ ] Hero media panel has 34px radius and a tactile 3D illustration with a mascot bubble.
- [ ] Buttons have the springy scale hover and compressed click.
- [ ] A short loader with a counter and progress line hands off to the hero with staggered line reveals.
- [ ] Mobile is single column with a pill CTA, hamburger and stacked buttons, with no horizontal overflow other than intentional marquees.
